request: I want to send ETH from my Safe. build me the template and its report

summary.en: The Safe sends the amount of ETH you type to the recipient you pick from your address book, as a plain transfer with no data. It calls no contract and leaves no allowance; a transaction with data, a delegatecall or another amount is refused.
summary.zh-TW: Safe 把你填的 ETH 數量，以不帶資料的單純轉帳，送給你從地址簿選的收款人。不呼叫任何合約，也不留下授權；帶資料、delegatecall 或金額不同的交易都會被拒絕。

text.en: A plain ETH transfer: one call with no data to your address-book recipient, no contract and no allowance.
text.zh-TW: 單純的 ETH 轉帳：一個不帶資料的呼叫，送到你地址簿的收款人，不經合約、不留授權。

text.en: When the recipient is a contract, sending ETH runs its code, which can pass the ETH on. verify checks only that the Safe gave exactly the amount to that address.
text.zh-TW: 收款人若是合約，轉入 ETH 會執行它的程式碼，它可以把 ETH 再轉走。verify 只檢查 Safe 剛好把這個數量給了那個地址。

recommendation.en: Put in your address book only addresses you control or know; to pay into a protocol's contract, ask for that protocol's own template.
recommendation.zh-TW: 地址簿只放你掌控或認識的地址；要轉入協議的合約，請要求該協議自己的模板。

pastTxsConclusion.en: Of the 12 that fit, 5 sent ETH to another address, 6 sent 0 ETH to the Safe itself, which cancels a queued transaction, and 1 sent 0 ETH to the zero address. No event marks an ETH transfer, so the search read every Safe's executions and reaches back only 5 days. Batches paying several addresses in one MultiSend, and 4 delegatecalls to contracts that are not MultiSend, do not fit this one-call template.
pastTxsConclusion.zh-TW: 符合的 12 筆中，5 筆把 ETH 轉給別的地址，6 筆轉 0 ETH 給 Safe 自己（取消排隊中的交易），1 筆轉 0 ETH 給零地址。ETH 轉帳沒有事件可找，所以搜尋讀每個 Safe 的執行紀錄，只回溯 5 天。一個 MultiSend 付給多個地址的批次，以及 4 筆 delegatecall 到非 MultiSend 合約的交易，都不符合這個單一呼叫的模板。
